profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. Its site uses the taglines "Own the study hour" and "Get unstuck." The company states that it is a Learneo, Inc. business and that it is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university.

Course Hero was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City. QuillBot is listed as a writing and editing product for paraphrasing. No litigation facts or MCP server integrations are present in the available material.
